messages:
priya: FYI the release pipeline is blocked — `typegen-check` failing on release/v1.14 and npm publish is stuck.
ci-bot: CI job `typegen-check` failed on commit 9f3a2b — regen diff detected. Log: https://ci.redwood.local/ci/9876
josh: ugh. Is this a spec change or codegen drift? quick diff?
maya: from CI output it looks like an optional property was added in the OpenAPI spec which changed generated types.
ken: running local regen now: `yarn openapi:regen && yarn typegen` — will paste diff in a sec
priya: small snippet from local diff:
```
- export type User = { id: string }
+ export type User = { id: string; email?: string }
```
maya: that is a source-breaking types change? runtime still returns email sometimes — if we've actually added a field it's a minor semver bump not patch.
josh: Agree — adding optional field should be minor (semver +1 minor). But it changes our SDK types; customers on strict TS will notice.
ken: quick workaround: pin codegen version to 0.9.2 (the last known good) in CI, unblock publish, follow up with a proper regen PR.
priya: pinning is ok as emergency. We need an action: regen, add changelog line, run e2e for a runtime compatibility smoke test, then publish a minor.
changelog-bot: Suggestion: "SDK: bump minor for generated types (User.email added) — ensure consumer-facing notes and migration guidance" — run `yarn changelog:prep` after regen.
josh: who wants the regen PR? I can take it if ken confirms no other model diffs.
ken: I'll run full spec-check and report back. ETA ~20m.
priya: thanks — tagging @eng-oncall if this hits more releases. Also let's add a CI guard: fail release if regen diff exists unless explicitly approved by a codegen owner.
maya: +1 on the guard. Also add a short note in the release template reminding to check `openapi:spec` changes.
priya: agreed. for now we'll pin, merge the hotfix, then follow with regen PR and changelog entry. :shipit:
ci-bot: Hotfix branch created: release/hotfix/pin-codegen-1775012345
priya: I'll open the changelog PR after the regen PR merges. thanks everyone.
